situation: I hate my job but I am scared to quit and seek a new career.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello
dialog.content_en: Hello

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello yaar, kis topic par tumhe talk karna hai?
dialog.content_en: Hello, what would you like to talk about?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe apni current job ko quit karne ko leke matlb serious anxiety ho rahi hai. Yeh extremely stressful hai par pay bahut accha karti hai.
dialog.content_en: I am having a lot of anxiety about quitting my current job. It is too stressful but pays well

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhare job mein kya specific reasons hain jo itne stressful ho gaye hain?
dialog.content_en: What makes your job stressful for you?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe many people ko deal karna padta hai jo hard financial situations mein hote hain aur yeh mujhe seriously upset karta hai.
dialog.content_en: I have to deal with many people in hard financial situations and it is upsetting

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya tum apne clients ki help karte ho ek better financial situation achieve karne ke liye?
dialog.content_en: Do you help your clients to make it to a better financial situation?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main try karta hoon, par often woh wahan nahi pahunch paate jo woh chahte hain. Jab safeguards lift honge toh many people apna home lose kar denge.
dialog.content_en: I do, but often they are not going to get back to what they want. Many people are going to lose their home when safeguards are lifted

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Par tum unko ek better future offer kar rahe ho as compared to what they currently have. Ho sakta hai woh na ho jo woh chahte the, par long run mein yeh unki help karta hai.
dialog.content_en: But you offer them a better future than what they have currently. It may not be what they wanted, but it helps them in the long run.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh true hai par sometimes mujhe feel hota hai ki mujhe apni feelings aur health ko first place dena chahiye.
dialog.content_en: That is true but sometimes I feel like I should put my feelings and health first

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main is feeling ko completely understand kar sakta hoon.
dialog.content_en: I can understand that.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya koi aur job available hai jo tumhe utna pay kare jitna tum currently make karte ho?
dialog.content_en: Is there another job that would pay you close to what you currently make?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Shayad nahi. Main same company ke saath kaafi long time se hoon aur mujhe consistently har saal bonus milta hai
dialog.content_en: Probably not. I was with the same company for a long time and I consistently get a bonus every year

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya yeh possible hai ki tum apne clients ki dire financial situations ko dekhne ka apna perspective reframe karo?
dialog.content_en: Is it possible to reframe how you look at your clients' dire financial situations?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main try kar sakta hoon. Honestly, at the end of the day yeh mujhe mostly get to karta hai.
dialog.content_en: I could try. It mostly gets to me at the end of the day

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kuch log woh nahi kar sakte jo tum karte ho kyunki unke paas woh heart nahi hota ki kisi ko bad news give kar sakein. Reality yeh hai ki someone needs to fill that role aur tum truly logon ki help karte ho.
dialog.content_en: Some people can't do what you do because they don't have the heart to give someone else bad news. The reality is though, someone needs to fill that role and you do help people

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That is also true. Sometimes main wonder karta hoon ki kya yeh actually mere liye hai bhi ya nahi.
dialog.content_en: That is also true. Sometimes I wonder if it really is for me though

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mera bhi collections ke saath experience raha hai jab main khud bad financial condition mein tha. Dusri taraf jo person thi woh really helpful thi, woh kaafi understanding thi,
dialog.content_en: I've had to deal with collections before when I was in  bad financial condition. The person on the other line was really helpful though. She was understanding,

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ho sakta hai yeh job tumhare liye suitable na ho. I think tumhe apni position ke pros and cons ke baare mein sochna chahiye, isse cheezein aur clearer ho jayengi.
dialog.content_en: It may not be for you. I think you should think about the pros and cons of keeping your position. It might make things clearer for you.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That is true. Maybe mujhe bas sit down karke iske baare mein seriously sochna padega.
dialog.content_en: That is true. Maybe I just need to sit down and really think about it

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Agar yeh tumhare mental health ko negative way mein impact kar raha hai toh I won't tell you to stay. Phir bhi, tumhe thoda zoom out karke bigger picture dekhne ki zaroorat hai: ki tum ek needed service provide karte ho aur woh bhi full compassion ke saath.
dialog.content_en: I wouldn't stay if it really impacts your mental health in a negative way. Still, you may need to zoom out and see the bigger picture: that you provide a needed service and you do it compassionately

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh truly ek bahut bada decision hai
dialog.content_en: It really is a big decision

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Different perspective dene ke liye thank you
dialog.content_en: Thank you for the different perspective

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: No doubt, par you know in your heart ki kya right hai tumhare liye.
dialog.content_en: No doubt, but you know in your heart what is right for you.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh sach hai. Thanks again yaar
dialog.content_en: That is true. Thanks again

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Bye
dialog.content_en: Bye

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Arre no problem. I hope tum is situation ke baare mein ek accha decision le pao aur phir uske saath at peace raho
dialog.content_en: It's no problem. I hope you can make a decision about this situation and then be at peace with it

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Theek hai, take care
dialog.content_en: Ok, take care

situation: I have been out of work for five weeks in quarantine due to testing positive for COVID-19.  I fear that my employer will not take me back to work even once I test negative.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi yaar, aaj aap kaisa feel kar rahe ho?
dialog.content_en: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello
dialog.content_en: Hello

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi :) Koi special topic discuss karna hai kya? Mind mein koi stress chal raha hai kya?
dialog.content_en: Hi :) Is there anything you'd like to talk about? Something on your mind?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main apne job ko lekar bahut concerned hoon. Main last 5 weeks se work se out hoon kyunki main COVID-19 positive test hua tha.
dialog.content_en: I'm concerned about my job. I have been out of work for the past 5 weeks because I tested positive for COVID-19.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh I am so sorry yeh sunkar! Tumhe at least sick pay mil rahi hai kya? Agar nahi, toh koi advice mil rahi hai kya about help you can access?
dialog.content_en: Oh I am so sorry to hear that! Are you at least getting sick pay? If not, are you getting advice about help you might be able to access?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh I am so sorry yeh sunkar! Tumhe at least sick pay mil rahi hai kya? Agar nahi, toh koi advice mil rahi hai kya about help you can access?
dialog.content_en: Oh I am so sorry to hear that! Are you at least getting sick pay? If not, are you getting advice about help you might be able to access?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: (Sorry yaar duplicate post ke liye, I am not sure ki kya issue hua!)
dialog.content_en: (sorry for duplication, not sure what happened there!)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It just keeps getting better... Maine Pandemic Unemployment Assistance ke liye apply kiya tha aur approve bhi ho gaya. Next day, mujhe ek email mila jisme identity verify karne ko bola (I am fine with that, it actually makes good sense)...
dialog.content_en: It just keeps getting better...  I applied for the Pandemic Unemployment Assistance and was approved.  The next day, I got an email asking me to verify my identity (I am fine with that.  It actually makes good sense.)...

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Toh matlab tumhe thodi assistance mil rahi hai na?
dialog.content_en: So you have been getting some assistance?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: So maine instructions follow kiye aur website par message aa gaya thanking me for verification. Following week mujhe ek physical letter mila ki main approved hoon aur award amount per week bhi mention tha.
dialog.content_en: So I did as instructed and got the message on the website thanking me for verification.  The following week I got a physical letter saying I was approved and the award amount per week.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main online gaya once a week aur qualify bhi kiya, jaise karna chahiye, and still mujhe ek cent bhi nahi mila.
dialog.content_en: I have gone online once a week and qualified, as one is supposed to do, and still I have not received a cent.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I see, toh matlab tum really financially struggling ho currently? Kisi aur place par assistance ke liye apply kar sakte ho kya? Foodbank ke baare mein kya thoughts hain?
dialog.content_en: I see, so you are really financially struggling at the moment? Is there anywhere else you could apply for assistance? What about a foodbank?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Customer service line call karna toh futile hai. Computer bas ek recording play karta hai ki agents other calls par busy hain aur phir call disconnect ho jaati hai.
dialog.content_en: Calling the customer service line is futile.  The computer just plays a recording that the agents are on other calls and then it disconnects the call.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hear you yaar - main bhi last time ek official matter ke liye bahut der tak hold par tha. I guess sabhi ko help aur advice chahiye right now, toh rush hoga.

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh sunkar lagta hai ki you did a very positive thing. I really hope ki woh log dhyan dein is par. Yeh situation definitely tumhara fault nahi hai!
dialog.content_en: That sounds like a very positive thing to have done. I really hope that they pay some attention to you. This situation is not your fault!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main is food bank pehle bhi gaya hoon, aur unhone mujhe bahut comfortable aur welcomed feel karwaya aur ek information package bhi diya on other ways the parent organization may assist me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Haan, they are run by lovely people. Humare wale ne toh humein cheap aur easy to make recipes ka pamphlet bhi diya tha.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am very lucky ki organization mujhse sirf 3 miles door hai. Main unke rent assistance aur employment assistance programs ko bhi look into karne wala hoon.
dialog.content_en: I am very lucky in that the organization is only 3 miles from me.  I will be looking into their rent assistance and employment assistance programs as well.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Toh at least yeh sunkar lag raha hai ki tumhara is par poora control hai aur apne level par sab kuch try kar rahe ho, am I right?
dialog.content_en: So, at least it sounds like you have a good handle on this and are doing everything you can to help yourself, am I right?

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh bahut encouraging sound karta hai! Yeh amazing hai ki even with cheap food tum kitna kuch bana sakte ho. For instance, noodles are very versatile :)
dialog.content_en: That sounds very encouraging! It's amazing what you can make even with cheap food. Noodles , for instance, are very versatile :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: You are right. Main definitely sit aur pout nahi karne wala. I am just thoda frustrated with the system.
dialog.content_en: You are right.  I am definitely not going to sit and pout.  I am just a bit frustrated with the system.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: It's a very strange situation and I suspect ki kuch authorities bas overwhelmed feel karti hain aur unhe idea hi nahi hai how to cope.
dialog.content_en: It's a very strange situation and I suspect that some of the authorities just feel overwhelmed and have no idea how to cope.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe concern hai ki mera boss mujhe job par wapas na le. Kyunki yeh ek "at will" state hai, woh mujhe without cause terminate kar sakta hai. Although legally woh COVID ki illness ki wajah se fire nahi kar sakta, par woh mujhe wapas lekar same day release kar sakta hai yeh kehkar ki I have become redundant.
dialog.content_en: I am concerned that my boss may try to not take me back at my job.  Because this is an "at will" state, he can terminate me without cause.  Although he can not legally fire me for being ill with COVID, he can take me back and simply release me the same day saying that I have become redundant.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh toh uski taraf se incredibly immoral hoga. Do you feel ki uska aisa karne ka chance hai?
dialog.content_en: That would be incredibly immoral of him. Do you feel that he is likely to do such a  thing?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I would not put it past him, sadly. Par maine attitude bana liya hai ki agar aisa hua, toh situation change karne ke liye I can do nothing. Main simply uske against wrongful termination ka charge pursue karunga aur ek new job seek karunga.
dialog.content_en: I would not put it past him.  Sadly.  But I have taken the attitude that if it does occur, there is nothing I can do to change the situation.  I would simply pursue a charge against him for wrongful termination, and seek a new job.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh ek bahut rational tareeqa hai things ko dekhne ka. I really hope ki aisi naubat aaye thank hi na! Baat karne ke liye thanks aur aane wale months ke liye all the best.
dialog.content_en: That is a very rational way to look at things. I really hope that it does not come to thank though! Thank you for talking and I wish you all the best for the coming months.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Shayad main suit win na karoon, par I would definitely file one. Year 2000 mein, ek employer ne mujhe without cause fire kiya tha. Maine sue kiya aur win bhi kiya. Not only did they have to pay me back wages for 90 days investigation period, which was no minor sum,
dialog.content_en: I may not win the suit, but I would definitely file one.  In 2000, I had an employer fire me without cause.  I sued and won that time.  Not only did they have to pay me back wages for the 90 days that the investigation took place, which was no minor sum,

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe glad feel ho raha hai ki tum chupchaap ill treatment accept nahi karte! Great job :)
dialog.content_en: I am glad that you'd not roll over and accept ill treatment! Well done :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: unhe guilty find kiya gaya, toh judge ne mujhe average 80 hour weeks based wages grant kiye jo maine work kiye the, poori vacation time, plus overtime jo mujhe milta, holiday pay, aur uske baad to put a nice bow on that gift, judge ne mujhe 5000 dollars damages bhi diye kyunki old company ne lie kiya tha ki I had broken the law.
dialog.content_en: they were found to be guilty, so the judge granted me my wages based on the average of 80 hour weeks I had been working, all my vacation time, plus the overtime I would have received, holiday pay, and then to put a nice bow on that gift, he awarded me 5000 dollars in damages because the old company lied and said I had broken the law.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe abhi jaana padega yaar par baat karne ke liye thanks :) (kya aap quit button press karke survey complete kar sakte ho?) Best wishes!
dialog.content_en: I am afraid I need to leave now but thank you for talking :) (can you press the quit button and take the survey?) Best wishes!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mera current employer actually jaanta hai ki yeh hua tha, kyunki years ago humne discuss kiya tha, aur maine use Department of Labor and Training ka award letter show kiya tha, itemizing judge's findings and awards.
dialog.content_en: My current employer actually knows this happened, because years ago we discussed it, and I showed him the award letter from the Department of Labor and Training, itemizing the judge's findings and the awards.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you for your time yaar. Have a great holiday enjoy karo.
dialog.content_en: Thank you for your time.  Have a great holiday.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Same to you yaar!
dialog.content_en: You too!

situation: I am depressed staying home due to COVID

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi! Kaise ho aap?
dialog.content_en: Hi! How are you doing?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main doing good hoon. Tum batao?
dialog.content_en: I am dong good. You?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main bhi fine hoon thanks, par yeh year kafi worrying chal raha hai. Tum bhi kisi matter ko lekar really worried ho kya?
dialog.content_en: I am okay thanks but it is a worrying year. Have you been worrying about anything?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Last March se COVID ki wajah se home par hi hoon yaar; honestly bahut depressed feel ho raha hai.
dialog.content_en: I have been staying home since last March due to COVID; getting very depressed.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah I understand, main bhi self-isolate ho gaya hoon. Tumhara koi online support network hai kya?
dialog.content_en: Ah I hear you, I have been self isolating too. Do you have an online support network?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Support network se tumhara exactly kya matlab hai?
dialog.content_en: What do you mean by support netwrok?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, aise friends jisse tum is difficult time mein talk kar sako? Mere paas Facebook aur similar platforms par kafi friends hain jisse main talk kar sakta hoon.
dialog.content_en: Well, friends you can talk to during this difficult time? I have a lot of friends on facebook and similar that I can talk to.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas very few friends hain jisse main talk kar sakta hoon par I'm not sure ki woh kaise help karenge.
dialog.content_en: I have few friends and can talk to but not sure how would they help.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Sometimes bas yeh know karke hi easy ho jata hai ki other people bhi tumhari hi situation mein hain :)
dialog.content_en: Sometimes it does just make it easier to know that other people are in the same situation as you :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Tumhara matlab friends ke beech experiences share karein?
dialog.content_en: You mean share experiences among the friends?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes.. ya phir at least coping mechanisms share kar lein?
dialog.content_en: Yes .. or at least share coping mechanisms perhaps?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhare paas koi aisi hobbies hain jismein tum khud ko right now occupy karke busy rakh sako?
dialog.content_en: Do you have any hobbies that you can occupy yourself with right now?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, main musical instruments play karta hoon par COVID ki wajah se band ke sath jam nahi play kar paya.
dialog.content_en: Yes, I pay musical instruments but do to COVID could not play with the band

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya tum Zoom meetings set up kar sakte ho jahan tum sab online ek sath play kar sako?
dialog.content_en: Could you perhaps set up Zoom meetings where you could play together online?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Koi idea hai ki ye kaise work karega? Kya different instruments ke sounds mein koi delay hoga kya?
dialog.content_en: Any idea how would it work? Would there be any delay between the sounds from different instruments?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: No I don't think so :) Mujhe lagta hai ki ye totally live hota hai toh tum perfectly waise hi play kar sakoge jaise tum real life mein together hote ho.
dialog.content_en: No I don't think so :) I think that it is totally live so you could play just as you would if you were together in person.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Idea ke liye thanks. Main ise try karke dekhta hoon.
dialog.content_en: Thanks for the idea. I will give it a try.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hope ki ye tumhare liye great rahe. Itna awful year raha hai na yeh?
dialog.content_en: I hope it goes well for you. It has been such an awful year, hasn't it?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, yeh toh... absolutely worst tha jo maine ever dekha hai..
dialog.content_en: Yes, it was.. worst I ever seen..

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main 2021 ke liye tumhe all the very best wish karta hoon. I hope ki tum apne band ke sath phir se mil sako aur rock karo!
dialog.content_en: I wish you all the very best for 2021. I hope that you get to get together with your band again and rock!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I hope so. Jaise ki vaccination start ho gayi hai toh kuch months mein sab kuch normal ho jana chahiye..
dialog.content_en: I hope so. As they started the vaccination everything should come back to normal in few months..

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Apne time aur support ke liye thanks.
dialog.content_en: Thanks for your time and support.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, humein bas patient rehne ki zaroorat hai! Have a great New Year and thanks for talking.
dialog.content_en: Yes, all we need to do is be patient! Have a great New Year and thanks for talking.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Bye
dialog.content_en: Bye

situation: I found out that my boyfriend had been lying to me about his entire life, and so the future that he had said we were building towards was all but impossible. I'm trying to figure out if I should stay with him.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello, life abhi tumhare liye kaisi chal rahi hai, honestly?
dialog.content_en: Hello, what is life like for you at the moment?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Infinitely complicated yaar.
dialog.content_en: Infinitely complicated.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Bahut saare decisions hain. I don't know kya karna chahiye.
dialog.content_en: Too many decisions. I don't know what to do.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am so sorry to hear that par I am happy to listen and help you agar main kuch kar saku toh
dialog.content_en: I am sorry to hear that but I am happy to listen and help you if I can

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tum kis sort ki cheezein decide karne ki try kar rahi ho?
dialog.content_en: what sort of things are you trying to decide?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I don't even know ki kahan se start karu main.
dialog.content_en: I don't even know where to start.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main yeh decide karne ki try kar rahi hu ki I can build trust with him again or not.
dialog.content_en: I'm trying to decide if I can build trust with him again.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: He lied about everything.
dialog.content_en: He lied about everything.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, let's try to take it one problem at a time taaki tum overwhelmed na ho jao. What is your biggest problem currently?
dialog.content_en: Well, let's try to take it one problem at a time so's not to get overwhelmed. What is your biggest problem at the moment?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah, kya main yeh assume karu ki koi relationship recently end hua hai?
dialog.content_en: Ah, am I to take it that a relationship has recently ended?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Jab hum meet kiye the, involve hone se pehle, he said ki woh divorced hai. Mujhe baad mein pata chala ki he is legally still married. Usne mujhe assure kiya tha ki unka divorce hone mein bas thoda time baaki hai.
dialog.content_en: When we met, before we got involved, he said he was divorced. I ended up finding out that he was still legally married. He assured me that they were just a pen's stroke away from being divorced.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That was March ki baat.
dialog.content_en: That was in March.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe three weeks pehle pata chala ki they are actually still living together.
dialog.content_en: I found out three weeks ago that they're actually still living together.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And, no. Humne abhi tak break up nahi kiya hai.
dialog.content_en: ANd, no. We haven't broken up yet.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah I totally hear you.. wohi purani 'we're getting divorced' line. Main bhi us phase se guzar chuki hu! You are well out of this.
dialog.content_en: Ah I totally hear you .. the old 'we're getting divorced' line. I've been in that one! You are well out of this.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main debate kar rahi hu. I don't know kya karu.
dialog.content_en: I'm debating. I don't know what to do.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe khud par gussa aa raha hai, I feel like a schmuck.
dialog.content_en: I feel like a schmuck.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: He has such pretty words aur baat karne ka tareeka.
dialog.content_en: He has such pretty words.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Apne personal experience se I think ki agar woh kehte hain ki divorce hone wala hai aur phir drag their feet, toh woh kabhi nahi hone wala.
dialog.content_en: From personal experience I think that if they say they're going to get divorced and then drag their feet it is never going to happen.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And woh humare upar kitna saara time aur effort invest karta hai.
dialog.content_en: And he invests so much time and effort into us.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main aapki baat se totally agree karti hu.
dialog.content_en: I agree with you.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mera mind agree karta hai.
dialog.content_en: My mind agrees.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meri yeh stupid emotions sab kuch cloud kar rahe hain.
dialog.content_en: My stupid emotions are clouding things.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, agar tum usko koi ultimatum do toh what do you think woh kya kahega?
dialog.content_en: Well, if you were to give him an ultimatum what do you think he would say?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine diya tha.
dialog.content_en: I did.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: LOL
dialog.content_en: LOL

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: And woh abhi bhi married hai?
dialog.content_en: And he's still married?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And he brought his kids to my mere ghar taaki woh mere kids se mil sakein. Usne unse baat ki thi about how he and their mother were living (ghar ke separate floors par).
dialog.content_en: And he brought his kids to my house so they could meet my kids. He had a conversation with them about why he and their mother had been living the way they had. (in seperate floors of the house)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That was two weeks ago ki baat hai.
dialog.content_en: That was two weeks ago.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Toh, yes, woh hai.
dialog.content_en: So, yes, he is.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Too soon to tell.
dialog.content_en: Too soon to tell.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main samajh sakti hu ki tumhe feel ho raha hai ke you are being cheated. Main tumhe bata nahi sakti kya karna chahiye par don't you think you deserve better?
dialog.content_en: I can tell that you feel that you are being cheated here. I can't tell you what to do but don't you think you deserve better?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I guess wahi main figure out karne ki try kar rahi hu. Kya mujhe use time dena chahiye to prove himself ab jab woh ek corner mein aa gaya hai.
dialog.content_en: I guess that's what I'm trying to figure out. Should I give him time to prove himself now that he's backed into a corner.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mera bolna sahi nahi hoga par I wonder ki kya woh sach mein change hoga jabki he has not already.
dialog.content_en: It's not for me to say but I wonder if he's really going to change as he has not already.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Iska answer dena itna easy nahi hai. Woh mujhe bahut acche se treat karta hai, always has. And ab jab use pata chal gaya hai, toh he is frantically trying to accommodate me.
dialog.content_en: That's not an easy question to answer. He treats me very well. Always has. And he is frantically trying to accomodate me, now htat I know.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I agree with you. Yeh mere biggest fears mein se ek hai.
dialog.content_en: I agree with you. It's one of my fears.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhare kids ka is baare mein kya kehna hai? And what about his kids?
dialog.content_en: How do your children feel about this? And his?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: MERE bache (6 aur 9 saal ke) uske saath reh rahe hain apni life mein ek male figure ke tarah jo father figure banta ja raha hai. Hum dono fifteen months se saath hain, aur six months se part-time live-in mein hain.
dialog.content_en: MY children (6 and 9) have been living with him in their lives as a male figure who is growing into a father figure. He and I have been together for fifteen months, and part-time living together for six.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh koi new relationship nahi hai. Isliye yeh situation aur complicated hai.
dialog.content_en: This isn't a new relationship. That's part of the complication, too.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Uske kids ne actually pucha tha ki can they come live with me jab tak he and his ex apna shit figure out kar rahe hain.
dialog.content_en: His kids actually asked if they could come live with me while he and his (ex?) figured their shit out.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, I can imagine ki yeh kitna tough hai. Jab children involved hote hain toh situation bahut difficult ho jaati hai. I know you would not want your kids to get hurt.
dialog.content_en: Yes, I can imagine that it is. It is always really difficult when children are involved. I know you would not want your children to be hurt

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh ek messed up situation hai jise COVID ne aur kharab kar diya hai. He was furloughed in May.
dialog.content_en: It's a messed up situation that COVID has not improved. He was furloughed in May.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Indeed main nahi chahti, you're right.
dialog.content_en: Indeed I don't, you're right.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hear you. Covid ne poori world ko disrupt kar diya hai toh this year bhi waisa hi raha! I can't wait for it to end.
dialog.content_en: I hear you. Covid has disrupted the whole world so might this year! I can't wait for it to be over.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Par ab aisa lag raha hai ki it will hurt them agar I break up with him.
dialog.content_en: But now it seems like it will hurt them if I break up with him.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Par unhe aur zyada hurt hoga the longer this situation goes on :(
dialog.content_en: But it will hurt them more the longer the situation goes on :(

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Kaash I could say ki I am confident ki 2021 better hoga, par...
dialog.content_en: I wish I could say that I were confident that 2021 would be better, but...

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Too right.
dialog.content_en: Too right.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And yeh sab isliye hai kyunki this is not a simple situation at all.
dialog.content_en: And this is all a part of why this is not a simple situation.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well isse zyada bura toh kya hi ho sakta hai :)
dialog.content_en: Well it surely could not be worse :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have no doubt ki he loves me very much yaar.
dialog.content_en: I have no doubt that he loves me very much.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hahahaha! Seems that way.
dialog.content_en: Hahahaha! Seems that way.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: He didn't make this lie up sirf mere liye. That's a very interesting thing.
dialog.content_en: He didn't make this lie up for me. That's an interesting thing.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Woh yeh "divorced dad" wala jhoot was living to A LOT of people.
dialog.content_en: He was living the "divorced dad" lie to A LOT of people.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Anybody and everybody jo utne door the ki they could be lied to.
dialog.content_en: Anybody and everybody who was far enough away to be lied to.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: She lives in her bedroom, sirf hafte mein two nights kaam karne ke liye bahar aati hai. Doesn't want anything to do with her kids (5, 9, 11, 13 years old).
dialog.content_en: She lives in her bedroom. Only comes out to work two nights a week. DOesn't want to have anything to do with her kids (5, 9, 11, 13)

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: (sorry afk tha mujhe catch up karne do)
dialog.content_en: (sorry was afk let me catch up)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And she aur mera BF have been living that way for three years. Over a year before I even met him.
dialog.content_en: And she and my BF have been living that way for three years. Over a year before I even met him.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya possible hai ki she is suffering from depression?
dialog.content_en: Is it possible she is suffering from depression?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main toh iski poori guarantee all but de sakti hu.
dialog.content_en: I would all but guarantee it.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe bas is baat ki worry hai ki he might treat you the same way if you were ever in the same position.
dialog.content_en: It just worries me that he might treat you the same way if you were ever in the same position

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yahan ek aur kicker hai, though...
dialog.content_en: Here's the other kicker, though...

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: She knows about me.
dialog.content_en: She knows about me.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: (I know. You're right. Maine bhi wahi socha tha)
dialog.content_en: (I know. You're right. I thought that as well)

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: And use tumhare baare mein kaisa lagta hai?
dialog.content_en: And how does she feel about you?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: She doesn't care at all. Woh bas status quo maintain rakhna chahti hai, she likes the money and security.
dialog.content_en: She doesn't care. She just wants to keep the status quo. She likes the money and security.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: (Before he was furloughed, woh bahut acche paise kamata tha.)
dialog.content_en: (before he was furloughed, he made very good money.)

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I think behtar hoga agar he were able to come to a sensible financial solution with her. Yeh situation sabhi ke liye damaging hai.
dialog.content_en: I think it would be better if he  were able to come to a sensible financial solution with her. This situation is damaging for everyone.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes!
dialog.content_en: Yes!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main agree karti hu!
dialog.content_en: I agree!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: EVERYBODY!
dialog.content_en: EVERYBODY!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hope main tumhari kuch help kar payi hu :) A very happy New Year to you!
dialog.content_en: I hope I have been able to have been of some help to you :) A very happy New Year to you!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Happy New Year!
dialog.content_en: Happy New Year!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhe bas quit press karke survey lena hai - it has to be done at your end :) roomId
dialog.content_en: You just need to press quit and take the survey - it has to be done at your end :)

situation: the uncertainty surrounding the corona virus pandemic. the unavailability of jobs. lack of success get jobs applied for. No ease or comfort of end being in sight

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi there, honestly kaise ho aap?
dialog.content_en: Hi there, how are you doing?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: aur better ho sakta tha
dialog.content_en: could be better

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am so sorry ye sunke. Kya aap kisi specific topic pe baat karna chahte ho?
dialog.content_en: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about anything specific?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you, mujhe genuinely samajh nahi aa raha ki job find karne ke liye what else should I do?
dialog.content_en: thank you, I just don't know what else to do to get a job?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: So you are unemployed? I am really sorry to hear that. Kya aap aise jobs lene ke liye ready ho jo aapke usual level se neeche hain bas kuch time manage karne ke liye?
dialog.content_en: So you're unemployed? I am sorry to hear that. Are you prepared to take jobs that are below your usual level just to get by for a while?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: try kiya hai par interview ka call bhi nahi aata
dialog.content_en: have tried that but don't even get an interview

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: It's a very difficult time to be out of work, I know. I really hope ki kuch accha mil jaye aapke liye. Kya aapne employment agencies try kiya hai?
dialog.content_en: It's a very difficult time to be out of work, I know. I hope that there is something out there for you. Have you tried employment agencies?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yes, mujhe unemployment benefit ke liye qualify nahi karte kyunki mere savings minimum threshold se upar hain aur mera ek rental property bhi hai jo currently loss mein chal raha hai aur main usko sell nahi kar sakta kyunki wo market value se 30% kam pe hai
dialog.content_en: yes, I do not qualify for unemployment because I have savings above the min threshold and I also have rental property, which is currently loss making and I can't sell it because it's 30% below market value

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, on the plus side kam se kam aapke paas savings toh hain.. hopefully isse aapko kuch time ke liye security mil jayegi
dialog.content_en: Well, on the plus side at least you do have savings .. hopefully this can give you some security for a while

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aapki family aapki is situation mein supportive hai?

dialog.content: I'm teaching myself the piano. Main ek stenography machine chalana bhi khud se sikh raha hoon for possible future employment as a stenographer. I also like to read novels.
dialog.content_en: I'm teaching myself the piano.  I'm also teaching myself  how to work a stenography machine for possible future employment as a stenographer.  I also like to read novels.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I have never understood ki woh kaise work karte hain.. mujhe yeh dekh kar amazing lagta hai ki someone can type out whole words or sentences with one stroke.
dialog.content_en: I have never understood how those work..I find it amazing someone can type out whole words or sentences with one word

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haan, yeh kaafi cool hai. Example ke liye, agar main ek hi stroke mein DRAT hit karun, toh machine ki LCD screen par English mein "Did there come a time" likha aa jayega.
dialog.content_en: Yeah, it's pretty cool.  For example, if I hit DRAT in one stroke, then "Did there come a time" will appear in English on my machine's  LCD screen.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Wow yeh toh crazy hai, I honestly don't understand ki yeh kaise work karta hai, kya yeh preprogrammed hota hai ya word ke sound ke hisaab se chalta hai?
dialog.content_en: Wow that is crazy, I don't understand how that works, is it preprogrammed or does it go by how the word sounds?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Har stenographer ka apna ek "Personal Dictionary" hota hai jo English words ki ek list hai, iske sath ki aap specifically un words ya phrases ko steno mein kaise write karte ho. Yeh dictionary actual steno machine ke andar hi present hoti hai jab aap ise apne laptop se cable ya wifi ke through machine mein transfer kar lete ho. Is tarah se aapki machine ko pata chal jata hai ki aap words ko specially kaise likhte ho aur unhein steno se English mein kaise translate karna hai - har stenographer thoda alag tarike se likhta hai.
dialog.content_en: Each stenographer has their own "Personal Dictionary" which is a list of words in English along with how you in particular write out those words or phrases in steno.  This dictionary is present within the actual steno machine after you transfer it from your laptop to the machine via cable or wifi.  Thus your machine then knows how you write out words in particular and how to translate those words from steno to English - each stenographer writes a little differently.

dialog.content: Haan, exactly! Aur apni personal dictionary ko cloud ya kisi separate drive par back up karna bahut important hota hai taaki hard-drive crash hone par aap ise lose na kar do. Us dictionary ko create karne mein bahut hard work lagta hai! Nahi, pehle bhi aisa ho chuka hai ki main holidays par alone raha hoon; par tumne mujhe cheer up karne mein help ki hai, so thanks!

situation: Not being able to see family and friends due to Covid.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello yaar
dialog.content_en: Hello

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi, aajkal kaisi feeling hai, how are you feeling today?
dialog.content_en: Hi, how are you feeling today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am not feeling good bilkul bhi. Mujhe thoda depression ho gaya hai, because of pandemic ki wajah se friends aur family se mil nahi pa raha hu.
dialog.content_en: I am not feeling the best. I have been having some depression, because of not being able to see friends and family during this pandemic.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh boy, I totally know that feeling! How are you dealing iske saath? (agar main puch saku)
dialog.content_en: Oh, boy, do I know that feeling! How are you dealing with it? (if I may ask)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I try my best ki unhe message karu aur phone par call karu, par it's just not the same as actually saamne se jaakar ek hug dena aur in person milna.
dialog.content_en: I try to message them as much as possible and call them on the phone but it is just not the same as actually getting to give the a hug and see them in person.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I know that yaar. Main Zoom use karta hu, bas unhe dekhne ke liye... kya tumhare paas computer hai?
dialog.content_en: I know that. I use Zoom, just to see them...do you have a computer?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, that works for kuch family, par nursing home mein ek family member hai jinke paas computer ka access nahi hai. I haven't seen them for several months. It just breaks my heart.
dialog.content_en: Yes. That works for some of my family but I have family in the nursing home that does not have access to computers. I haven't seen them in several months. It just breaks my heart.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh, I totally can feel it. Mera bhi koi sick hai. Do you have koi aisi friend jiske saath you can share your feelings, apna depression? I understand ki you're having issues with depression, right? Mujhe kabhi kabhi yeh soch kar thoda accha lagta hai ki we're all in this together. And is sab ke end mein, we will be able to give the biggest hugs ever!
dialog.content_en: Oh. I can feel it. I have someone who's sick as well. Do you have any one friend with whom you can share your feelings, your depression. I understand you're having issues with depression, right? It sometimes helps me to feel that we're all in this together. And, at the other end of this, we will be able to give the biggest hugs ever!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, I have some very dear friends jinhone meri bahut help ki hai. I guess depression aur zyada badh gaya hai because holidays chal rahe hain aur this is the first year ki mujhe extended family ke saath spend karne ko nahi mila.
dialog.content_en: Yes. I have some very dear friends that have helped me a lot. I guess the depression is just worse because it is the holidays and this is the first year that I haven't got to spend it with my extended family members.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh, that's so tough yaar ki it's the first year!! Kabhi kabhi, I cry (main apne cat ke saath rota hu), aur bas feelings ko loud bolne se hi it makes me feel a bit better.
dialog.content_en: Oh....That's so tough...it being the first year!!!! Sometimes, I cry (I cry with my cat), and just to say the feelings out loud makes me feel a bit better.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeah, I have a little dog jo mera cuddle buddy raha hai. I have had him for 13 years toh usne mujhe bahut baar ugly cry karte hue dekha hai. What are some things you do to deal with depression?
dialog.content_en: Yeah. I have a little dog that has been my cuddle buddy. I have had him for 13 years so he has seen me ugly cry many times. What are some things you do to deal with depression?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I try to read, aise programs ya podcasts dekhta hu jo negativity ko away le jaye. Anything that will give me a lift, taaki mera depression itna bad na ho jaye ki I can't remember what it feels like to be a bit happy.
dialog.content_en: I try to read, watch programs or podcasts that take away my negativity. Anything that will give me a lift, so that my own depression won't get so bad that I can't remember what it felt like to be a bit happy.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That sounds like some very good advice. Mujhe lagta hai ki I will try to find a good podcast ya koi comedy series jo mujhe pasand ho aur usi mein time spend karu. It's really hard to be sad jab aap kuch funny dekh rahe ho ya sun rahe ho. Thank you for the good advice aur listening ear ke liye.
dialog.content_en: That sounds like some good advice. I think I will try to find a good podcast or a good comedy series that I like and spend time doing that. It's hard to be sad when you are watching something funny or listening to something funny. Thank you for the good advice and the listening ear.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I wish ki I could listen to more....yeh cheez is so slow. Yaad rakho, we're all in this together, and we will come out the other end. Isn't it OK to be happy thoda sa, even though yeh itne saare logo par itna bada toll le raha ho?
dialog.content_en:
I wish that I could listen to more....this thing is so slow. Remember, we
're all in this together, and we will come out the other end. Isn't it OK to be happy a bit, even though this takes such a toll on so many people?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Woh baat absolutely true hai. I guess humein guilty feel hota hai agar hum happy ho kyunki right now duniya mein itna saara sadness hai. But you are totally right ki we will definitely come out on the other side. Yeh yaad rakhna help karta hai ki bad things are not forever.
dialog.content_en: That is so true. I guess we tend to feel guilty if we feel happy since there is so much sadness in the world right now. But you are so right about the fact that we will come out on the other side. It helps to remember that bad things don't last forever.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, aur kya aap aisi jagah ho jahan you can walk ya exercise kar sako? Mujhe always better feel hota hai agar I can move around...dance...kuch active karu. What actually helps me the most is remembering ki we need to stay safe and OK, taaki we will be here to celebrate jab yeh sab over ho.
dialog.content_en: Yes, and are you somewhere where you can walk or exercise a bit? I always feel better if I can move around...dance...something active. What I find helps me the most is to remember that we need to stay safe and be OK, so that we will be here to celebrate when this is over.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haan, I live in the countryside toh jab weather accha hota hai toh I can go for nice walks. Staying safe abhi ke time mein definitely bahut important hai.
dialog.content_en: Yes. I live in the country so I can go for nice walks when the weather is nice. Staying safe is definitely important right now.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh...kitni fortunate baat hai ki you live in the country. Can you take kuch deep breaths and look at the trees, the animals, and nature....they are sab yahan hamare liye hi toh hain???
dialog.content_en: Oh...it's fortunate that you live in the country. Can you take some deep breathes and watch the trees, the animals, and nature....they are all here for us???

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haan wahi toh main exactly karta hu. Aaj meri help karne ke liye bahut bahut thanks. Tumhe apni baatein batane ke liye bas kisi ko paas paakar hi mujhe better feel ho raha hai.
dialog.content_en: Yes that is exactly what I do. Thank you so much for your help today. You have made me feel better just having someone to vent to.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Keep venting, agar isse you feel better. I know I do jab I can talk to kisi aise person se jise I don't know. Is the weather nice wahan today, taaki you can look at something bigger than the indoors?? Woh aksar helps me feel better.
dialog.content_en: Keep venting, if it makes you feel better. I know I do when I can talk to someone I don't know. Is it nice where you are today, so that you can look at something bigger than the indoors?? That often helps me feel better.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes. Yahan aaj weather bahut pretty hai. In fact, mujhe lag raha hai ki mujhe ek nice walk ke liye nikalna chahiye. I hope ki aapka din wonderful ho aur sunne ke liye thank you.
dialog.content_en: Yes. It the weather is very pretty here today. As a matter of fact, I think I am fixing to go for a nice walk. I hope you have a wonderful day and thank you for listening.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You bet, mujhe umeed hai ki tumhein bahut zyada better feel hoga aur tum kal tak yeh apne saath carry kar paoge--ki Christmas ke ek din baad tumhara ek accha din rahaaaaa!!!!
dialog.content_en: You bet, I hope you feel so much better and can take that with you tomorrow--that you had a good day on the day after Christmas!!!!

seeker_question1: I liked being able to talk to someone and vent about my feelings.
supporter_question1: No. The seeker was depressed and, after identifying the issues, the seeker felt better about their situation.
supporter_question2: I feel that this could be beneficial for everyone to help each other!

situation: My ex partner is harassing me and will not stop talking to my friends and family.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello
dialog.content_en: Hello

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi! How are you feel kar rahe ho today?
dialog.content_en: Hi! How are you today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have been better se hoon.
dialog.content_en: I have been better

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: It sounds like you might be upset. Can you tell me ki kya chal raha hai?
dialog.content_en: It sounds like you might be upset. Can you tell me what’s going on?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mera ex partner aur mera breakup kaafi long time pehle ho gaya tha because usne mujhe cheat kiya tha. Now wo mere friends aur family ko contact karna aur social media par posts dalna stop nahi kar raha.
dialog.content_en: My ex partner and I broke up a long time ago because they cheated on me. Now they will not stop contacting my friends and family and posting about me on social media

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh kaafi difficult aur stressful situation lag rahi hai. When you see it happening, toh aap kya reaction dete ho?
dialog.content_en: That sounds difficult and stressful. What do you do when you see it happening?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I usually bas document kar leta hoon aur kuch time ke liye offline jaane ka try karta hoon. It is hard to ignore.
dialog.content_en: I usually just document it and try to not go online for a while. It is hard to ignore

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Lagta hai ki you are avoiding favorite things apni unke actions ki wajah se. Mujhe lagta hai documenting yeh ek good idea hai! Have you tried reporting them for harassing you?
dialog.content_en: It sounds like you are avoiding things you enjoy because of their actions. I think documenting it is a good idea! Have you tried reporting them for harassing you?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have tried, par everyone just bolta hai ki there is nothing they can do because unhe nahi lagta ki ye dangerous ya criminal hai at this point.
dialog.content_en: I have tried but everyone just tells me there is nothing they can do because they don't think it is dangerous or criminal at this point

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh bohot frustrating hoga honestly. Can you tell me agar you have tried other things unhe stop karne ke liye?
dialog.content_en: That must be very frustrating. Can you tell me if you’ve tried other things to get them to stop?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine unhe in person confront kiya tha par to say the least wo kaafi dramatic tha. Unka basically meltdown ho gaya tha ki wo mujhe lose nahi karna chahte
dialog.content_en: I have confronted them in person but it was dramatic to say the least. They basically had a meltdown that they don't want to lose me

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapne right thing karne ka try kiya aur unke liye move on karna difficult ho raha hai. Social media ke through jo ongoing comments hain, it sounds like they are wanting your attention. Yeh aapke liye exhausting ho sakta hai. In my past, mujhe bhi kisi ko block karna pada tha who did something similar to me. Agar my friends mentioned seeing something from my ex, toh I asked them to keep it to themselves or consider blocking them too. Jo log mere closest the they understood what was going on, and I realized ki jo log mujhe nahi jaante the, they didn't matter. Would you be willing to suggest this to your friends or family agar isse ex ko interactions se remove karne mein help ho sake?
dialog.content_en: You tried to do the right thing and they are having a difficult time letting go. The ongoing comments through social media sounds like they are wanting your attention. That can be exhausting for you. In my past, I had to block someone who did something similar to me. If my friends mentioned seeing something from my ex about me, I asked them to keep it to themselves or consider blocking them,too. The people who were closest to me understood what was going on and I realized that people who didn’t know me, didn’t matter. Would you be willing to suggest this to friends or family if it would help to remove the ex from your interactions?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have encouraged my friends bhi to block them, par ek naya account hamesha pop up ho jata hai. My ex really will not give up.
dialog.content_en: I have encouraged my friends to block them as well, but a new account always pops up. My ex really will not give up.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I see. How long se ye chal raha hai and is this a daily occurrence ya kisi specific time par hota hai?
dialog.content_en: I see. How long has this been going on and is this a daily occurrence or does it happen at certain times?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh at least 6 months se ho raha hai now aur usually every weekend happen hota hai.
dialog.content_en: It has been happening for at least 6 months now and it usually happens every weekend

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main aapki frustration feel kar sakta hoon. Yeh kabhi-kabhi overwhelming ho sakta hai aur weekends se darr lagne lagta hai. Lag raha hai ki ye aapke ex ki habit ban gayi hai. Shayad isse help ho agar aap unhe ek letter likho jisme explain karo ki aap move on karne ke liye ready ho aur unse bhi wahi karne ko bol rahe ho. Explain karo ki aap unhe [list some of the details you have documented] in ways se harassment stop karne ka opportunity de rahe ho. Unhe inform karo ki agar unne stop nahi kiya, toh aap harassing communications ke regarding ise aur aage le jaane ka consider kar rahe ho aur ye letter aapke unke actions ko aur tolerate na karne ke intention ko represent karta hai. Ise certified mail ke through send karo aur ek copy apne paas rakho. Isse unke paas immediately respond karne ka koi way nahi hoga aur agar wo continue karne ka decide karte hain toh ye official documentation ka first step hoga. Kya aapko lagta hai ki isse help ho sakti hai?
dialog.content_en: I can sense your frustration. It must be overwhelming at times and make you dread the weekends. It sounds like it has become a habit for your ex. It might help if you write a letter to them explaining that you are ready to move on and are asking them to do the same. Explain that you are giving them the opportunity to stop harassing you in the following ways [list some of the details you have documented]. Inform them that if they do not stop, you are considering taking it further regarding harassing communications and that this letter serves as your intention to no longer tolerate their actions. Send it via certified mail and keep a copy. This will give them no way to immediately respond and would be the first step of official documentation should they decide to continue.  Do you think that might help?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe lagta hai yeh ek excellent idea hai! That is a really good way to end this once and for all.
dialog.content_en: I think that is an excellent idea! That is a good way to end this once and for all.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main sincerely hope karta hoon ki ye aapke logon ke sath interact karne ke tarike par control wapas paane ki taraf ek step ho. Main isse deal karne mein aapko best wish karta hoon aur hope karta hoon ki aap iske baare mein jald hi better feel karne lago, especially ek new year mein enter karte hue!
dialog.content_en: I sincerely hope it is a step toward you regaining your control  over how you are able to interact with people. I wish you the best in dealing with this and hope you begin to feel better about it soon, especially entering into a new year!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you very much!
dialog.content_en: Thank you very much!

dialog.content: Yeh year ka time bahut hard hota hai kafi saare people ke liye.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content: Ugh. Woh actually sabse worst hai.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kuch aisa hai jo aap think kar sako jo aapko better feel karane me help kar sake?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aisa feel hota hai ki cheezein unresolved way me end hui hain, jisse lagta hai ki koi real conclusion nahi mila.

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Ok fine, kisi breakup ke baad kisi ko bhulna is so hard yaar.
dialog.content_en: Ok fine , it's so hard to get over someone after a breakup like this.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, I agree with you. Sabhi emotions ko process karne me sometimes thoda time lagta hi hai.
dialog.content_en: Yes, I agree. Sometimes it just takes time to process all the emotions.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I mean logically, mujhe pata hai ki it's not. Agar hume break up karna hi tha, toh we were gonna break up.
dialog.content_en: I mean logically , I know it's not. If we were gonna break up, then we were gonna break up

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, that's a good point. Lagta hai ki you are thinking this through in a good way, par emotions ko process karna hard hota hai. Khud ko apne emotions feel karne dena ek important part hai is difficult situation se move on karne ke liye.
dialog.content_en: Yes, that's a good point. It sounds like you are thinking this through in a good way, but the emotions are hard to process. Letting yourself feel the emotions is an important part of getting through a difficult situation.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Par I want to keep his photos. And main khud ko itna kaise distract karu ki I'd stop thinking about him completely.
dialog.content_en: But I want to keep his photos. And how would I even distract myself that much that I'd stop thinking about him completely.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Photos rakhna is totally understandable. Distract karna shayad solution na ho; usse aap emotions ko process nahi kar paoge. Relationship end hone par grieving ka ek stage hota hai jo aana hi hai. Us person ke liye aur us relationship ke liye grieving hogi hi. Move on karne ke liye is sab ko process karna padta hai.
dialog.content_en: It is understandable to want to keep photos. Distracting yourself might not be the solution; that could stop you from processing the emotions. There is a stage of grieving for a lost relationship that happens when a relationship ends. There will be grieving for the person, and for the relationship with that person. That is what has to be processed in order to move on.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Ok, I mean, main try kar sakti hu. But baat yeh hai ki I don't want to leave him behind. I miss him so much.
dialog.content_en: Ok, I mean , I can try, But it's just, I don't want to leave him behind. I miss him

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That makes sense; aap usse care karte ho isliye you miss him. Yeh aisi cheez hai jisme thoda time lagega. Apne emotions ko accept aur acknowledge karna, chahe woh painful hi kyu na ho, emotions ko evolve hone dega aur over time woh kam painful ho jayenge.
dialog.content_en: That makes sense; you care about him so you miss him. This is one of those things that will take time. Accepting and acknowledging the emotions, even when they are painful, will let the emotions evolve and over time they will become less painful.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: But he is gone. I know ki yeh bahut badly hurt karta hai.
dialog.content_en: But he's gone. I know it hurts so badly.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, yeh ek bahut painful experience hoga. Relationship ka end hona ek loss hai, aur ek grieving process se toh gujarna hi padta hai. That is definitely a painful experience. I am so sorry ki aapko yeh sab face karna pad raha hai. I believe ki you can manage this experience and end up a stronger person.
dialog.content_en: Yes, it must be a painful experience. The end of a relationship is a loss, and there is a grieving process to go through. That is a painful experience. I am sorry you have to go through this. I believe that you can manage this experience and end up a stronger person.

It has been awhile, but I remember getting her gift and it was over sometime afterwards. Do you have any co-workers or involvement with any local groups/organizations/church?

dialog.content: Mere co-workers ko meri personal life ke baare mein nahi pata, and main church bhi nahi jata. Maybe mujhe kisi therapist ko consult karna chahiye?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I think ek therapist ek great way hoga is situation ko process karne ke liye because hamare paas time limited hai. Insured aur uninsured dono ke liye great therapists available hote hain. :)
dialog.content_en: I think a therapist would be a great way to process this situation since our time is limited. From what you shared, it sounds like you have some past hurts that you may want to share with someone you trust. Do you have insurance or are you uninsured? dialog.content: Mere paas insurance nahi hai, main abhi between jobs hoon aur currently mere paas kuch nahi hai. Yeh holidays especially ek lonely time lagta hai.

situation: I have been recently laid out because of COVID-19 and not solved yet.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello yaar.
dialog.content_en: Hello.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main another job search kar raha hoon preferably apni locality ke andar hi aur last 2 months se nahi mili. Agar aage ke 3 months bhi same chala toh mere liye sustain karna extremely difficult ho jayega.
dialog.content_en: I am looking for another job preferably in my locality and not getting yet, since last 2 months. I will find it difficult to sustain if this continues like this for other 3 months.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Toh sunke aisa lag raha hai ki you have been struggling to find a new job. In times mein new job search karna is never easy. Tumhe kya lag raha hai ki why are you having trouble?
dialog.content_en: So it sounds like you've been struggling with finding a new job. It's never easy looking for a new job during these times. Why do you think you're having trouble?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Job milna utna difficult nahi hai. But main locality mein hi job find karne ki try karta hoon taaki family se distance na ho aur food issues bhi face na karne padein.
dialog.content_en: Getting a job is not that difficult. But I try to find a job in my locality to avoid distant from family and having food issues.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Sunke lag raha hai ki you are motivated and dealing with a lot. Kya koi specific job thi jo tumhare mind mein thi, ya phir you are applying to different kinds of jobs?
dialog.content_en: It sounds like you're motivated and dealing with a lot. Is there a specific job that you had in mind or are you applying to different kinds of jobs?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Kisi bhi tarah ki job chalegi, probably managerial. But locality mein rehna zaroori hai taaki apni aged mom ko bhi look after kar sakoon.
dialog.content_en: Any kind of job, probably managerial. But to be in my locality since to look after my aged mom also.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aisa lag raha hai ki you really care to be close to home. Kya apne kabhi kisi se locally baat ki hai about jobs that would allow you to stay close to home?
dialog.content_en: It sounds like you really care to want to be close to home. Have you talked with someone locally about jobs that would allow you to stay close to home?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine kuch aise people se talk kiya hai jinko mere friends bhi jante hain. Woh interest show karte hain but is specific issue par meri help nahi kar pa rahe hain.
dialog.content_en: I have been talking to some people who my friends knows also. They show interest but cannot help me on the issue.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Surely woh kuch logo ko refer karenge. But isme thoda time lagega.
dialog.content_en: Surely they will refer to some people. But it will take some time.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Stay motivated yaar. Agar ek opportunity se desired response nahi milta, toh you are actually closer to finding the right job. Keep pushing on aur remember ki agar ek opportunity work out nahi hoti, a positive attitude will make sabhi difference. Just because you haven't found one yet doesn't mean ki milegi nahi.
dialog.content_en: Stay motivated. If one opportunity doesn't get your desired response you may be even closer to finding the right job for you. Keep pushing on and know that if one opportunity doesn't work out a positive attitude will make all the difference. Just because you haven't found one yet doesn't mean you won't.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Confidence boost karne ke liye thanks. I feel relaxed now. Main believe karta hoon ki yeh surely ek chance hoga khud ko find karne ka aur apni previous difficulties se relief pane ke liye ek better opportunity milne ka. I believe GOD ne hi mujhe is way mein force kiya hoga.
dialog.content_en: Thanks for making confidence. I feel relaxed. I believe this will surely be a chance to find myself and get a better opportunity to be relieved from my previous difficulties. Only GOD should have forced me this way, I believe.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhara faith healthy hai aur tumhe purpose provide karta hai. Similarly tumhe yeh believe karna hoga ki dots definitely connect honge in your favor. Maybe you can't connect them looking forward, but looking backwards you must trust ki dots future mein connect honge.
dialog.content_en: Your faith is healthy and gives you purpose. Similarly you have to believe that the dots will connect in your favor. Maybe you can't connect them looking forward, but looking backwards you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe apne previous employer par thoda anger feel hua kyunki woh mujhe switch karne ke liye koi time nahi de rahe the, at least 2 months ka.
dialog.content_en: I felt anger over my previous employer since he was not giving any time for me to switch over, at least 2 months.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Even tab tak toh woh fully satisfied the.
dialog.content_en: Even then he was satisfied till then.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Apne last job par focus karke frustrated feel karna normal hai, especially agar abhi tak nayi job nahi mili. Perhaps ek baar jab tumhe new job mil jaye, toh last job wali disappointment utni disappointing nahi lagegi. Agar new job better hai, toh tum purani job mein kaam karte rehke shayad woh find nahi kar paate.
dialog.content_en: It can be frustrating to focus on your last job, especially if you haven't found a new one yet. Perhaps once you find a new job your disappointment with the last one won't be so disappointing anymore. If the new job is better you wouldn't have found it working the last job.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Anyhow meri loyalty ko encourage nahi kiya gaya ki main aur better perform karun. Mujhe phir se kisi aur starting point se move karna hoga.
dialog.content_en: Anyhow my loyalty was not encouraged to perform more. I have to move from some back again.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Anyways main khud ko better prepare kar raha hoon, is break time ko use karke apni knowledge ko aur gain kar raha hoon aur skills ko sharpen kar raha hoon, net aur YouTube par bahut saare articles read aur view kar raha hoon. It helps me a lot.
dialog.content_en: Any I am preparing myself better, using the break time to gain my knowledge further and sharpen my skills, reading and viewing many articles in the net and youtube. I helps me a lot.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh bahut acchi baat hai ki you're staying productive and improving yourself. Agar apne aap ko improve karne ki tumhari desire utni hi strong hai jitni new job find karne ki, toh I'm confident you will succeed.
dialog.content_en: It's great that you're staying productive and improving yourself. If your desire to improve yourself is as strong as your desire to find a new job I'm confident you will.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh mujhe past ko completely forget karke future par concentrate karne mein immensely help karta hai.
dialog.content_en: It helps me to forget the past and concentrate on the future.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Don't let your past define you yaar, apne present choices se ek new path pave karo into the future.
dialog.content_en: Don't let your past define you, let your present choices pave a new path into the future.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main bas continuously aage move kar raha hoon. Mujhe feel ho raha hai ki I am very close to the treasure, bas yeh idea nahi hai ki kitne aur hits dig karne padenge.
dialog.content_en: I am going forward only. I think I am very close to the treasure, not knowing how many hits to dig.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe ek better prospectus ke liye aapki greetings chahiye.
dialog.content_en: I require your greetings for a better prospectus. .

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am fully confident ki tum definitely karoge.
dialog.content_en: I'm confident you will.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhara matlab kya hai?
dialog.content_en: What do you mean?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Motivation ke liye thanks. . . .
dialog.content_en: Thanks for your motivation. . . .

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: BYE BYE
dialog.content_en: BYE BYE

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mere sath share karne ke liye thanks. Take care now.
dialog.content_en: Thanks for sharing with me. Take care now.

seeker_question1: Quite motivating and relaxed on the problem
supporter_question1: Couldn't tell if the seeker was a real person or not
supporter_question2: Closure was difficult because you don't know if it helped them or not.

situation: I had been dating my college boyfriend for almost a year and we had begun to fight increasingly over the last few months.  He ended up breaking up with me on our anniversary.

dialog.content_en: Hello.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main bas yahan hoon, I am here.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aap kaise ho, how are you feeling?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Not too well honestly. Main right now pretty down feel kar raha hoon.
dialog.content_en: Not too well.  I am feeling pretty down right now.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kitne time se aapko lag raha hai ki you are not feeling so well?

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: He broke up with me today.
dialog.content_en: He broke up with me today.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hum school (apne college campus) mein the, aur humari ek huge fight ho gayi.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I probably yeh sab dekh nahi payi, we have been fighting bahut saara lately.

dialog.content: That's true, par isse mujhe right now thoda bhi better feel nahi ho raha.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: Yes, everything can feel worse this time of year because of the stress of the holidays.

dialog.content_en: I have actually read about that, but I have a hard time focusing when I meditate.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I suppose I just need to practice more.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: What else can I do besides meditation?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Candles mere liye much better option hain.
dialog.content_en: Candles are much better for me.
