dialog.content: Maine is website ke bare mein pehle nahi suna tha. I'll definitely check it out.
dialog.content_en: I haven't heard of that website before.  I'll have to check it out.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main aisi sites visit karta tha jo un people ki help karti hain jinhe relationships mein issues aur fights ke baad decompress karne ki need hoti hai.
dialog.content_en: I used to visit sites that help people who need to find ways to decompress after issues and fights have occurred in relationships.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Well, main aisi long-term relationship mein pehle kabhi nahi rahi hoon.
dialog.content_en: Well, I haven't been in a long-term relationship like this before.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meri past relationships all high school mein thi, jo bas few weeks ya months tak last karti thi.
dialog.content_en: My past relationships were all in high school, and they only lasted a few weeks or months at a time.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I really cared for him, aur hum itne long time se together the.
dialog.content_en: I really cared for this one, and we were together for so long.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe feel hota hai ki Christmas par help karna meri duty hai kyunki mera bhi one year gifts ko lekar partner ke sath nasty fight ho gaya tha.
dialog.content_en: I feel obligated to help during Christmas because I had a nasty fight with my partner one year over gifts.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Aapki apne partner ke sath fight hui thi? I'm so sorry, yeh worst hota hai jab log kisi nice cheez par fight karte hain.
dialog.content_en: You had a fight with your partner?  I'm sorry, it's the worst when people fight over what's supposed to be something nice.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Fight kis cheez par thi? Food? Money? Sex?
dialog.content_en: What was the fight over? Food? Money? Sex?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I forget ki kis cheez se start hua, it was something stupid. Use mera kuch kehna pasand nahi aaya aur wahan se blow up ho gaya.
dialog.content_en: I forget what started it, it was something stupid.  He didn't like the way I said something and it kind of blew up from there.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Last few months se hum smallest things par hi fight kar rahe the.
dialog.content_en: We were fighting over the smallest things these last few months.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It just kind of built up to the point where he said he couldn't take fighting with me anymore and just wanted to end it.
dialog.content_en: It just kind of built up to the point where he said he couldn't take fighting with me anymore and just wanted to end it.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main things ko ek long time ke liye decompress hone dunga.
dialog.content_en: I would let things decompress for a long while.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Relationship end karna, I mean ki wohi keh rahi hoon.
dialog.content_en: End the relationship, I mean.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Aapko lagta hai ki agar hum kuch time apart lein, toh shayad he might want to talk about it?
dialog.content_en: You think maybe if we just take some time apart, he might want to talk about it?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I suggest ki agar uska hot temper hai, toh relationship end karne ke bare mein sochna chahiye.
dialog.content_en: I suggest thinking through ending the relationship if he has a hot temper.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Woh really very easily upset ho jata hai.
dialog.content_en: He does get upset very easily.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, bas some time ke liye iske bare mein achhe se think karo.
dialog.content_en: Yes, just think it through for some time.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I do think yeh important hai ki some time liya jaye aur breathe kiya jaye.
dialog.content_en: I do think it is important to take some time and breathe.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya uske sath relationship kaafi months tak pleasant rahi thi?
dialog.content_en: Was the relationship with him pleasant for many months?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, humare time together ka most part wonderful tha.
dialog.content_en: Yes, for most of our time together it was wonderful.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: He made me laugh very easily.
dialog.content_en: He made me laugh very easily.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh bhi ek reason hai ki I am so sad ki usne relationship end kar di.
dialog.content_en: That's part of why I'm so sad that he ended the relationship.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapne kaha ki last two months mein hi sab rough hua hai?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Two or three, yes.
dialog.content_en: Two or three, yes.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Aur hum smallest things par fight karte the, it was really stupid.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: You said that he has announced to you he has ended the relationship on Christmas?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapka matlab aaj hi?
dialog.content_en: Today, you mean?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, aur aaj humari one year anniversary thi.
dialog.content_en: Yes, and it was our one year anniversary.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: We were supposed to order takeout and watch a movie and exchange presents.
dialog.content_en: We were supposed to order takeout and watch a movie and exchange presents.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Instead humne fight ki aur breakup ho gaya.
dialog.content_en: Instead we fought and broke up.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: In my opinion, I would consider accepting ki yeh bilkul bhi healthy relationship nahi hone wali.
dialog.content_en: In my opinion, I would consider accepting that it is not going to be a healthy relationship whatsoever.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I think aap absolutely right ho.
dialog.content_en: I think you are right.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Unless we kisi sort ki counseling ke liye jayein.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: But it probably sabse best ke liye hi hai.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Maine dekha hai ki aisi situations mein things aur bhi worse ho jati hain. I think use accept karna chahiye ki use grow up hone ki need hai.
dialog.content_en: I have seen things only get worse in a situation like yours.  I think h needs to accept that he needs to grow up.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aap dono ki age kya hai?
dialog.content_en: How old are the both of you?

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: Any other counseling that I can give?

situation: I had been terminated from a job that was in my field. I had to move back in with my parents.

dialog.content_en: I had the job for 14 months and I drank a lot before bed which was usually about 1 am. The job was second shift. The drinking affected my REM sleep and I was often tired the next day.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: I can understand that...

dialog.content_en: I had a sleep study done soon after and was diagnosed with Sleep Apnea which was the main reason I would fall asleep at work.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.content_en: Ouch, that's no good...  I understand medical issues can cause all kinds of problems in our lives.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main last 6 years se CPAP use kar raha hoon aur apni drinking ko dramatically reduce kiya hai. Yeh kitna amazing hai ki ab main poora din refreshed feel karta hoon compared to any day during that time, even those days jab maine drink nahi kiya tha because overall health effects mere saath reh gaye the.
dialog.content_en: I have been using a CPAP for 6 years and have dramatically reduced my drinking. It is amazing how refreshed I am all day now compared with any day during that time even the days I didn't drink because there were overall health effects that stayed with me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I understand..

situation: My girlfriend and I broke up due to all the fights we were having. It was mutual but it was still sad. I felt as if my life had ended and everything was in black and white. I was sad for a year afterwards.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello, aaj tum kaisa feel kar rahe ho? Is there anything you'd like to talk about?
dialog.content_en: Hello, how are you feeling today? Is there anything you'd like to talk about?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main bohot sad hoon kyunki maine apni one year girlfriend ko lose kar diya.
dialog.content_en: I am sad because I lost my girlfriend of one year.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh I am so sorry ye sunke - yeh toh actually bohot terrible time of year hai break up ke liye. Please know ki time ke sath things better ho jayengi!
dialog.content_en: Oh I am so sorry to hear that - this is a terrible time of year to get dumped. Please know that it will get better in time!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Why do you think ki sab theek ho jayega?
dialog.content_en: Why do you think it will get better?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, bhale hi yeh cliché lage, but time really helps in healing wounds. Mujhe bhi kaafi time laga tha ek break up se move on karne mein. We had been together eight years!
dialog.content_en: Well, although it sounds like a cliche, time does help with healing wounds. It took me a while to get over a break up. We had been together eight years!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That must've been hard. Kya bina kisi naye partner ke heal karna possible hai?
dialog.content_en: That must've been hard. Is it possible to heal without finding another?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes I think ki yeh possible hai, but you really do need to be kind to yourself aur time dena padega. Do you have good friends jo tumhe support karein?
dialog.content_en: Yes I think that it is but you really do need to be kind to yourself and give it time. Do you have good friends to support you?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere bohot saare friends nahi samajh paayenge kyunki woh long-term relationships mein hain. But yes, I have a few good friends.
dialog.content_en: Many of my friends wouldn't understand as they are in long-term relationships. But yes, I've a few good friends.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: At least yeh ek blessing hai, baaki I know ki jab aap single ho toh doosro ko happy relationships mein dekhna thoda hard hota hai.
dialog.content_en: That is a blessing at least though I know it can be hard to see people in happy relationships when you are single.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Partner ko lose karne ke first year mein cope karne ke liye tumne kya kiya tha?
dialog.content_en:
What did you do to cope in the first year of losing your partner
?

dialog.content: What sort of hobbies ne tumhari help ki thi?
dialog.content_en: What sort of hobbies helped you?

Well, I do love to write but sometimes the 
sadness just burns me out completely and I stare at the empty page.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Do you feel ki shayad you didn't treat her as well as you actually could have done?

dialog.content: Yes! Jitna work hai uske sath positive rehna bahut hard hai aur mujhe lag raha hai ki I am not doing well.

dialog.content: Yes, that can be tough. dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Example ke liye, agar you have 7 classes, toh you can make a chart for when you will study for each class and then check them off as you accomplish it, shayad ek din mein sab nahi, thode reasonable bits mein break karke. dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Jab bhi mere paas koi large project hota hai aur motivation lose ho jaati hai, toh main apne goals paper par set karti hoon, phir usko smaller bites mein break kar deti hoon. dialog.content_en: Whenever I have a large project and lose motivation, I set my goals on paper, then break it down into smaller bites. For example, I will make sure I work one hour on certain days, or call a friend, I generate ideas to keep me on track.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, mujhe bhi kai baar guilty feel hota hai and then face nahi karna chahti, lekin actually best thing yeh hai ki aap recognize karo you are NOT the first person she knows jo behind ho gayi ho. So she is surely experienced with people who need some encouragement. She is the BEST person to go to, actually.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That sounds like a really good idea, paper par likhna definitely helpful hoga.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Isne hamesha meri help ki hai. For example, aap isko 4 weeks mein break kar sakte ho, phir har week apne goals likho -- maybe put call Advisor or go stop by every week, lekin main usko first week ke liye sabse pehle rakhungi.

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Isi liye ek timeline hona accha hota hai. For example, aap goal banao ki aap reference aur citation page par one hour ke liye work karoge, uske baad you are DONE. One hour is reasonable.
dialog.content_en: That is why a time line is good. For example, you make a goal that you will work on your reference and citation page for one hour, after that, you are DONE, If you have time at the end, you can revisit it. The hour is my suggestion, you make your own. lol THAT way, you don't get caught going on and on for 6 hours to make it perfect. One hour is reasonable.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That definitely sounds reasonable. Micro deadlines rakhna shayad wahi hai jo mujhe focused rakhne ke liye chahiye.

hello

situation: I had to throw out my 13 year old sister.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello yaar.
dialog.content_en: Hello.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello, tumhara mood abhi kaisa hai? My name is Jo.
dialog.content_en: Hello, how are you at the moment? My name is Jo

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main absolutely okay hoon I suppose.. Aap kaise ho??
dialog.content_en: I am doing okay I suppose.. How are you??

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main bhi quite fine hoon. Is there koi aisi baat jiske baare mein tum aaj discuss karna chahte ho?
dialog.content_en: I am not so bad. Is there anything you'd like to talk to me about today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes yaar. Mujhe apni sister ko kuch din pehle ghar se throw out karna pada tha aur I am kind of upset over it.
dialog.content_en: Yes. I had to throw out my sister the other day and Im kind of upset over it.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh sunkar I am really sorry. Iska exact reason kya tha, aur had you been having problems for a while?
dialog.content_en: I am sorry to hear that. What precipitated that, had you been having problems for a while?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Woh kuch time ke liye psych ward mein thi aur jab discharge karne ka time aaya, toh my mother didn't want her back. Woh use foster home bhejne wali thi toh I volunteered ki main use apne paas le aaungi.
dialog.content_en: She was in a psych ward for a while and when it was time to discharge her, my mother didnt want her back. She was going to send her to a foster home so I volunteered to take her in.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Tab se, she has stopped taking her medication aur kafi ajeeb behave kar rahi hai.
dialog.content_en: Since then, she has stopped taking her medication and is acting out.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah, toh you feel as though tumhari mom ko help karni chahiye thi aur you were put into an impossible position jiske liye you were not prepared?
dialog.content_en: Ah, so you feel as though your mother could and should have helped and you were put into an impossible position you were not prepared for?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Pretty much yaar.
dialog.content_en: Pretty much.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I can totally sympathise with you kyunki mere bhi siblings hain with extreme mental health problems - main bhi us phase se guzra hoon aur mujhe pata hai yeh kitna difficult hota hai.
dialog.content_en: I can sympathise with you having siblings with extreme mental health problems - I have been there too and I know how difficult it is.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine try kiya ki my mother take her back, par she still didn't want her there. Toh maine use apni grandmother ke paas send kar diya aur she turned that side of the family against me.
dialog.content_en: I tried to have  my mother take her back, but she still didnt want her there. So I sent her to my grandmothers and she turned that side of the family against me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mentally ill log unfortunately kabhi kabhi manipulative ho jaate hain, though unka intention waisa nahi hota. Have you had any contact with her since?
dialog.content_en: Mentally ill people can unfortunately sometimes be manipulative, though they do not mean it. Have you had any contact with her since?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Sirf once hi aur tab she was just telling me ki I was a horrible person.
dialog.content_en: Only once and she was just telling me that I was a horrible person.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh sab start hi tab hua jab usne apni meds stop kar di thi aur maine use room clean karne ko bola.
dialog.content_en: This all started over her stopping her meds and then I asked her to clean her room.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh kafi toxic lag raha hai. Is it possible ki use medical help ke liye persuade kiya jaye? I realise ki she might be reluctant.
dialog.content_en: That sounds very toxic. Is it possible to persuade her to seek medical help? I realise she might be reluctant to

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: We have tried ki use wapas therapy mein dalein. Par COVID put a block on that.
dialog.content_en: We have tried to get her into therapy again. But, COVID put a block on that.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine suggest kiya ki she go back to the ward aur shayad kisi group home mein place ho jaye.
dialog.content_en: I suggested that she go back to the ward and maybe be placed into a group home.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah yes, abhi ka time is a terrible time at the moment isn't it? Mujhe lagta hai a lot of people ko woh medical help nahi mil pa rahi hai jo unhe chahiye because of the virus.
dialog.content_en: Ah yes, it is a terrible time at the moment isn't it? I think a lot of people are not getting the medical help that they need because of the virus

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Please do not beat yourself up over this - sach mein aisa lag raha hai ki you have done absolutely everything you could to help.
dialog.content_en: Please do not beat yourself up over this - it does sound as though you have done absolutely everything you could to help.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main hate karungi agar aisa kuch ho, par I am completely at my wits end yaar.
dialog.content_en: I would hate to see that happen, but Im at my wits end.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I can tell ki tumhein is baare mein kitna bura feel ho raha hai just from your tone of voice. Please remember ki you can't fix everything in the world.
dialog.content_en: I can tell that you feel really bad about this just from your  tone of voice. Please remember that you can't fix everything in the world.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Ab my dad's side of the family hates me kyunki unka kehna hai ki I was mean to her. Maine toh bas asked her to clean her room and maybe socialize every once in a while.
dialog.content_en: Now my dads side of the family hates me because they say Im "mean to her". All I asked her to do was to clean her room and maybe socialize every once in a while.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main sad hone se zyada mad hoon yaar.
dialog.content_en: Im more mad than sad.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Socialising karna mental health problems wale logon ke liye hard ho sakta hai. Shayad yeh best hota agar tumne us par zyada pressure nahi dala hota, though I know ki tumhara intent galat nahi tha.
dialog.content_en: Socialising can be hard for people with mental health problems. It might have been best if you did not press her too hard to do that though I know you did not realise.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main understand karti hoon, par mujhe lagta hai ki yeh poore din dark room mein baithne se toh better hi hota.
dialog.content_en: I understand, but I think it would have better than sitting in a dark room all day.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya use depression bhi hai? That might account for her trying to shut herself away from everyone.
dialog.content_en: Does she suffer from depression also? That might account for her trying to shut herself away

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haan, par woh is baat ko whole heartedly deny karti hai.
dialog.content_en: Yes, but she denies it whole heartedly.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yahi reason hai ki she was taking medication in the first place.
dialog.content_en: This is why she was taking medication.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main completely understand kar sakta hoon ki people ko medicine lena kitna difficult ho jata hai jab woh refuse karte hain yeh recognise karne mein ki unhe koi problem hai.
dialog.content_en: I understand that it can be very difficult to make people take medication if they refuse to recognise that they have a problem.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I just wish ki she could see what I see...
dialog.content_en: I just wish she could she what I see...

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Unfortunately that is not likely to be possible. All you can do is be kind to yourself aur yeh jano ki you really did try to help.
dialog.content_en: Unfortunately that is not likely to be possible. All you can do is be kind to yourself and know that you really did try to help her

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe fear tha ki woh apni attitude ki wajah se meri family ko completely ruin kar degi.
dialog.content_en: I was afraid she was going to ruin my family with her attitudes.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hope ki main thodi help kar paya hoon. I really appreciate ki tumne comfortable feel kiya mere saamne apna dil kholne mein.
dialog.content_en: I hope that I have been able to help a little. I really appreciate that you felt that you could open up to me

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you. Mujhe kafi better feel ho raha hai kisi ke saamne rant karne ke baad.
dialog.content_en: Thank you. I feel better being able to rant to someone.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You're welcome. Have a lovely festive season! Mujhe lag raha hai ki in the coming year sab kuch aur better ho jayega.
dialog.content_en: You're welcome. Have a lovely festive season! I feel that all will be better in the coming year.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhein apne end se quit press karke survey lena hoga :)
dialog.content_en: You need to press quit from your end and take the survey :)

dialog.content_en: I am okay I guess, I am really stressed and not sure how to handle it

dialog.content:
Well first of all it is completely normal to feel that way. Mujhe lagta hai hum sabhi ko aisa hi feel hota hai bas koi openly bolta nahi hai. Also friends aur family se door rehne ki wajah se self-doubt hota hai kyunki shayad tumhe lagta hai ki tumhare paas lean karne ke liye trusted log nahi hain.

dialog.content_en: Do you have any tips on how to deal with headaches or being overly stressed or anxious?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Anxiety aur stress ke liye I would suggest ki apne saare chores aur tasks se thoda break lo aur just be to yourself. Tumhein kya karna pasand hai? Maybe ek cup tea ya phir The Office ka ek episode. You always have to take some me-time for yourself
dialog.content_en: For anxiety and stress i would sugesst taking time out away from all your chores and tasks and just be to yourself. What is something you enjoy? May a cup of tea or an episode of the office. You always have to take a moment for yourself

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Toh something like going for a run, ya koi funny movie dekhna?
dialog.content_en: So something like going for a run, or watching a funny movie?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Meditation, yoga, ek warm bath—yeh sab bhi bahut soothing ho sakta hai. Sometimes kinetic energy burn karna bhi help karta hai like brisk walk pe jana taaki anxiety wali adrenaline burn ho jaye
dialog.content_en: Meditation, yoga, a warm bath these things can also be soothing as well. SOmetimes using kinectic energy up can help as well like going for a brisk walk to burn off the adrenaline that causes anxiety

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you so much in ideas ke liye
dialog.content_en: Thank you for the ideas

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Par what if itna stress ho jaye ki you can't really think of anything else?
dialog.content_en: But what if you get so stressed you can't really think of anything else?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes! Heck go all out aur dono cheezein karo if tumhare paas treadmill hai ha ha! Do whatever makes YOU happy chahe bas ek moment ke liye hi kyun na ho.
dialog.content_en: Yes! Heck go all out and do both is you have a treadmill ha ha ! do what makes YOU happy even if just for a moment

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: If tumhara stress level itna high ho gaya hai, then you go ahead and acknowledge that anxiety jo tumhare andar chal rahi hai. Usse apna attention do, apne eyes close karo aur khud se poochho ki iski root kya hai jo mujhe itna dara rahi hai. What is the exact thing main afraid hoon ya worried hoon? Jab hamare thoughts race karne lagte hain toh focus karna hard ho jata hai aur hum mistakes karte hain jo stress ko aur badha deta hai.
dialog.content_en: IF your stress has become that high, then you go ahead and aknowledge the anxiety that is flowing through you. Give it you attention and close your eyes and start to ask yourself what is the root of what is scaring me. What is the official thoing i am afrad of or worried about. When our thoughts begin to race its hard to focus and we make mistakes and that adds to the stress.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you so much, apki advice sach mein bahut helpful hogi!
dialog.content_en: Thank you so much, your advice will be really helpful!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Would you like some links to a webpage or group jahan aur bhi tips aur advice mil sakein?
dialog.content_en: Would you like any links to a webpage or group that may also have tips or advice?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I think main theek hoon, par mujhe itni achhi tips dene ke liye thank you so much
dialog.content_en: I think it is fine, but thank you so much for giving me tips

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You're very welcome! I genuinely hope ki tum apne bache hue holiday ko enjoy kar sako
dialog.content_en: Youre very welcome! I hope that you are able to enjoy the rest of your holiday

seeker_question1: I liked how the supporter sympathized and was very helpful with their tips and information
seeker_question2: Maybe faster response time between people (if it was slow because of connection)

situation: My girlfriend of 2 years left me for another person.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello yaar, tum kaise feel kar rahe ho?
dialog.content_en: Hello, how are you

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Not doing well at all. I can't believe ki meri girlfriend ne mujhe dump kar diya kisi aur ke liye.
dialog.content_en: Not doing well.  I cant believe my girlfriend dump me for someone else.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh no, tum log kitne time se together the?
dialog.content_en: Oh no, how long had you been together?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: We were together for 2 years. Yeh ek bohot bada surprise tha jab usne achanak yeh sab mujh par spring kar diya.
dialog.content_en: we were together for 2 years.  It was such a surprise when she sprung this on me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Wow yaar, yeh toh truly horrible hai. How do you feel about it?
dialog.content_en: Wow, that's horrible. How do you feel about it?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I feel completely lost yaar. Main itna used ho gaya hu uske everyday aaspas hone ke, ki ab I don't know ki without her what should I do with myself.
dialog.content_en: I feel lost.  I'm so used to her being around everyday. Now I don't know what to do with myself without her.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I completely understand, main bhi apni wife ke sath 4 years tak tha before she up and left without saying a single word.
dialog.content_en: I understand, I was with my wife for 4 years before she up and left without saying a word.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That can be ek bohot hi hard thing go through karne ke liye, especially is time of the year mein.
dialog.content_en: That can be a hard thing to go through especially this time of year

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Not only that, but yeh Covid chal raha hai toh I have no one I can see to talk about it.
dialog.content_en: Not only that, but with Covid going on I have noone i can see to talk about it.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tumhari koi family hai kya yahan local area mein?
dialog.content_en: Do you have any family?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, I do, par woh log bahut far away hain.
dialog.content_en: Yes, i do, but they are far away.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Koi friends closeby rehte hain kya?
dialog.content_en: Friends closeby?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Any hobbies?
dialog.content_en: Hobbies?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Waise tum kis type ka work karte ho?
dialog.content_en: What kind of work do you do?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I do have friends, jo uske bhi friends hain. Par unki families hain and they do not visit people because of Covid.
dialog.content_en: I do have friends, who are also friends with her. However they have families and do not visit prople because of covid.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I don't have any true hobbies. Mujhe nahi lagta woh is void ko fill kar paengi anyways.
dialog.content_en: I don't have any true hobbies. I don't think they will fill the void anyways.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well you know, maine yeh observe kiya hai ki sometimes humein time chahiye hota hai khud ke liye to fully understand ki how we need to grow.
dialog.content_en: Well you know, I have found sometimes that we need time to ourselves in order to fully understand how we need to grow.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I do software development, par yeh work from home situation hai. Toh I have been just by myself last week se, aur yeh mujhe crazy bana raha hai. All I do is think about ki usne aisa kyun kiya.
dialog.content_en: I do software development, but its a work at home situation.  So i have been just by myself for the last week, and its driving me crazy.  All i do is think about why she would do that.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I've had plenty of time to myself par yeh bilkul bhi better nahi ho raha hai.
dialog.content_en: I've had time to myself but its not getting any better.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Maine hamesha try kiya hai ki I should think of things in a positive way. Isse yeh hota hai ki even when something really bad happens, woh itna overwhelming nahi lagta ki hum recover na kar sakein.
dialog.content_en: I have always tried to think of things in a positive way. This way even when something really bad happens, it doesn't seem so bad as to overwhelm us from recovering.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yahan par kya positive cheez hai yaar?
dialog.content_en: What positive are there here?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main actually try kar raha hu Software Development field mein enter karne ka, how do you like it?
dialog.content_en: I'm actually trying to get into the Software Development field, how do you like it?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, market mein plenty of opportunities hain out there. Not to mention, itne achhe profession mein hone ki wajah se, you probably aren't hurting for money.
dialog.content_en: Well, there is plenty of opportunity out there. Not too mention, being in that profession, you probably aren't hurting for money.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It's ok yaar, pays the bills. Par mera job pretty independent hai, toh I don't even get to meet new people. Main usually ghar par hi rehta hu, jabki woh toh day time mein hamesha out of the house rehti thi.
dialog.content_en: It's ok. pays the bills. But my job is pretty independent.  so i don't even get to meet new people.  I am usually home, while she was always out of the house during the day.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tum us stress ko jo build up ho gaya hai use kar sakte ho to find a new outlet.
dialog.content_en: You can use that stress that has been building up to find a new outlet for the stress.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: What, tum chahte ho ki main cheezein todun to relieve stress?
dialog.content_en: what, you want to break stuff to relieve stress

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I completely understand yaar. Meri wife bhi yahi sochti thi ki I was just playing on the computer all day, lol.
dialog.content_en: I completely understand. My wife used to think I was just playing on the computer all day, lol.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main run karta hu.
dialog.content_en: I run

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Har morning main about 2 miles jog karta hu, yeh blood flow ke liye awesome hai to start the day.
dialog.content_en: Every morning, I jog about 2 miles. It is awesome to get the blood going and a great way to start the day.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh sunkar lagta hai ki I can try this. Koi aur suggestions hain kya?
dialog.content_en: That sound like something i could give a try.  any other seggestions?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Running ke baad I feel so much more relaxed, aur lagta hai ki uske baad nothing can hurt me.
dialog.content_en: I feel so much more relaxed after running and it seems that nothing can hurt me after that.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Well, main abhi hi running ke liye jaane wala hu. Thanks for the suggestion yaar, I'll see if that helps me.
dialog.content_en: Well, i'm going try going for a run right now.  Thanks for the suggestion.  I'll see if that helps.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I know ki ek programming job kaise social life ko affect karti hai, toh maybe try and go to a bar or somewhere social.
dialog.content_en: I do know how a programming job can take away from some social aspects of your life, maybe try and go to a bar, or somewhere social to get out some.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: No problem yaar, I hope ki maine tumhari kuch help ki ho.
dialog.content_en: No problem, I hope I have helped you some.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Happy Holidays!
dialog.content_en: Happy Holidays!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I really appreciate yeh talk aur suggestions yaar. Main try karunga, have a great night.
dialog.content_en: Appreciate the talk, and suggestions.  I'll give it a try.  Have a great night.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Good night, take care.
dialog.content_en: Good night

situation: Well, my wife of 10 years just decided to request a divorce, which is very unexpected.  She is saying that she is moving out with the two kids.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Well, yeh week honestly bahut hi hard raha hai.
dialog.content_en: Well, it has been a hard week.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meri wife ne decide kiya hai ki wo two kids ke sath mujhe separate kar legi.
dialog.content_en: My wife decided to separate from me with the two klids.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: What's been going on yaar, kuch batao?
dialog.content_en: Whats been going on?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh no, yeh toh bilkul bhi good nahi hai.
dialog.content_en: Oh no, that's not good

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am totally disgusted.... bilkul waise hi jaise President Donald Trump $600 dollar stimulus checks se hain.
dialog.content_en: I am disgusted....just like President Donald Trump is with the $600 dollar stimulus checks.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ain't that the truth, yeh toh truly exactly true hai yaar.
dialog.content_en: Ain't that the truth.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Isme meri koi fault nahi hai honestly.
dialog.content_en: It just isn't my fault.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meri wife ke paas koi right nahi tha ki wo mujhe leave karke California chhod de.
dialog.content_en: My wife had no right to leave California without me.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine California ko apna home banakar ek mistake kar di.
dialog.content_en: I made a mistake making California my home.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I'm sure ki aisi baat nahi hogi, aap log kitne time se together the?
dialog.content_en: I'm sure it isn't, how long had you been together?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: California beautiful hai I know, par wo kafi quick paced bhi ho sakta hai.
dialog.content_en: California is beautiful I know, but it can also be pretty quick paced.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hum log 10 years se together the. I am just disgusted ki ye is point par hua hai. Christmas week, wo bhi is week mein.
dialog.content_en: We were together 10 years.  I am just disgusted that it had to happen at this point. Christmas week, of all weeks.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aap abhi bhi working hain right now?
dialog.content_en: Are you still working?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main abhi bhi working hun right now. Luckily, California mein bureaucrat type ke logo ke liye bahut sara money hai.
dialog.content_en: I am still working right now.  Luckily, California has plenty of money for bureacrats lie myself.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine marriage mein apna contribution toh diya tha for sure.
dialog.content_en: I contributed to the marriage for sure.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I really love my wife aur mere great kids bhi.
dialog.content_en: I love my wife and my great kids

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ye important hai ki aap yeh know karo ki aapko apne loss ke bare mein jaisa bhi feel ho raha hai, that's okay. Is time of year mein aisi cheezein bahut tough hoti hain.
dialog.content_en: It's important that you know that you can feel whatever way you need to about your loss. Its a tough time of year for something like that.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya things pehle se hi pretty rocky chal rahi thi?
dialog.content_en: Had things been pretty rocky?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Things aise sudden the yaar. I mean, maine kabhi expect nahi kiya tha ki wo kids ke sath achanak walk out kar jayegi.
dialog.content_en: Things like this were sudden.  I mean, I never expected her to up and walk out with the kids.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main bas guess hi kar sakta hun ki California kafi expensive ho raha tha aur homeless log LA ko take over kar rahe the; shayad ishi reason se wo state chhod kar gayi.
dialog.content_en: The only thing I can think of was that California was getting too expensive and the homeless were taking over LA; that may have spooked her to leave the state.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Wow, yeh toh kafi horrible hai. It seems ki aapke paas us aspect mein koi legal authority honi chahiye thi.
dialog.content_en: Wow, that's horrible. It seems you should have some kind of legal authority in that aspect.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya wahan par ye ek real big problem hai?
dialog.content_en: Is that a big problem out there?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas honestly koi discourse nahi hai. Kids almost 18 ke hain aur twins hain. Yeah, uski nazar mein wo state se fed up lagti hai. Wo mujhe nahi balki Texas state ke liye chhod kar gayi.
dialog.content_en: I really don't have any discourse.  The kids are almost 18.  They are twins. Yeah, in her eyes, she seems fed up with the state. She left me for Texas, the state, not the person.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I mean, usne kabhi "Text" ko love karne ki baat nahi ki, par kids Dallas Cowboys ke kafi into hain.
dialog.content_en: I mean, she never mentioned loving, "Text," but the kids are bing into the Dallas Cowboys

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh important hai ki aap understand karo ki it seems wo is baare mein kafi time se soch rahi thi.
dialog.content_en: It is important that you understand that it seems that she has been thinking of this for a while.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine use overhear kiya tha yeh bolte hue ki Texas ek free state hai aur mere twin boys ko Dallas Cowboy's team sach mein pasand hai.
dialog.content_en: I overhead her say that Texas is a free state and my twin boys do love the Dallas Cowboy's team.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya wahan uski family members hain?
dialog.content_en: Does she have family there?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, wo wahan hain. Uske both parents Laredo mein rehte hain..... ek big spread ke sath.
dialog.content_en: Yes, she does. Both her parents live in Laredo.....big spread, too.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Jab se wo chhod kar gayi hain, kya aapne usse kuch conversation ki hai?
dialog.content_en: Have you spoken with her since she left?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Well, wo two days ago chali gayi. Main ghar aaya toh dekha ki furniture aur meri widescreen TV sab gayab the.
dialog.content_en: Well, she left two days ago.  I came home and the furniture and my widescreen TV were all gone.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hum LA mein ek small apartment mein rehte the.
dialog.content_en: We lived in a small apartment in LA.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That's mind-boggling yaar...
dialog.content_en: That's mid-boggling..

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am D-I-S-G-U-S-T-E-D to the Nth degree, honestly main bilkul disgusted feel kar raha hun yaar.
dialog.content_en: I am D-I-S-G-U-S-T-E-D to the Nth degree.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aapke paas koi specific hobbies hain?
dialog.content_en: Do you have any hobbies?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Use wapas come back karne ke liye koi bhi help mil jaye toh that would be accha.
dialog.content_en: Any help to get her to come back would help.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meri hobbies abhi on hold hain..... pehle mujhe "un-disgusted" hona padega.
dialog.content_en: My hobbies are on hold.....I need to get "un-disgusted" first.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well, main use bring back toh nahi kar sakta, par main aapko kuch information provide kar sakta hun ki in tough times se kaise deal karna hai.
dialog.content_en: Well, I can't make her come back, but I can provide you with some information on how to get through these tough times.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Ok.
dialog.content_en: ok.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am all ears yaar, sun raha hun...
dialog.content_en: I am all ears.....

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I understand, dusre ways se stress bahar nikalne mein help milna accha hota hai. Kya aap exercise karte ho?
dialog.content_en: I understand, it can be good to help get some stress out in other ways. Do you excercise?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapke kis type ke hobbies hain?
dialog.content_en: What kind of hobbies do you have?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas gym membership hai.... agar COVID-19 restrictions ki wajah se wo open honge toh.
dialog.content_en: I have a gym membership....if they are even open with the COVID-19.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Shayad main everyday jog ya speed walk kar sakta hun. Perhaps pushups se kuch help mil jaye?
dialog.content_en: Maybe I can just jog or speed walk every day.  Perhaps pushups can help?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe every morning run karna pasand hai, aur it seems isse kafi sara stress evaporate ho jata hai.
dialog.content_en: I like to run every morning, and it seems to help make alot of stress evaporate.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Oh, isse shayad mujhe relax hone mein aur apni wifey aur twin kiddos ke alawa doosri things ke baare mein think karne mein help mil jaye.
dialog.content_en: Oh, that may just help me relax and think about other things besides my wifey and twin kiddos.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Well, aapka input kafi helpful raha hai.
dialog.content_en: Well, your input has helped.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Maine apne liye toh yahi find kiya hai ki running ek amazing stress reliever hai.
dialog.content_en: I have found for me anyway, that running is an amazing stress reliever.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main aapke insights par thoda vichar karunga. Good bye.
dialog.content_en: I will mull your insights over.  Good bye.

supporter_question2: more time to answer back at the end

situation: I was dating this guy for about a month or so, and everything had been going well. It was my first relationship in a long time. All of a sudden, he ghosted me. No explanation. I was left thinking that I'm not built to be in a relationship.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main usko online occasionally dekhti hoon, but I don't know why usne mujhe drop kar diya.
dialog.content_en: I still see him from time to time online, but I don't know why he just dropped me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tum kisko online dekhti ho?
dialog.content_en: Who do you see online?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Usne tum par kya drop kiya?
dialog.content_en: What did he drop on you?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main occasionally us guy ko online dekhti hoon jiske sath main date kar rahi thi, and it makes me feel sad all over again.
dialog.content_en: I occasionally see the guy that I was dating online, and it makes me feel sad all over again.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Usne hamara relationship drop kar diya.
dialog.content_en: He dropped our relationship.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya tum uske notifications block kar sakti ho?
dialog.content_en: Can you block notifications for him?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kitna time ho gaya usne ye sab stop kiya?
dialog.content_en: How long ago did he stop it?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine iske bare mein seriously socha tha, par for some stupid reason, main sochti rehti hoon, "What if he comes to his senses and wants to contact me?"
dialog.content_en: I thought seriously about that, but for some stupid reason, I keep thinking, "What if he comes to his senses and wants to contact me?"

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: A couple months ago, par main abhi tak over it nahi hui hoon.
dialog.content_en: A couple months ago, but I haven't gotten over him.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Agar tum usko block karogi and agar woh touch mein aana chahega, toh woh koi rasta dhoond lega. Make him work hard yaar!
dialog.content_en: If you block him and he wants to get in touch, he will find a way.  Make him work hard

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Tujhe sach mein lagta hai ki playing hard to get work karega?
dialog.content_en: You really think playing hard to get will work?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe lagta hai agar woh abhi bhi interested hai toh it will work, nahi toh it's his loss.
dialog.content_en: I think if he is interested still it will, if not his loss.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thanks for saying that, par mujhe abhi bhi ek relationship mein rehne ki problem hai.
dialog.content_en: Thanks for saying that, but I still have the problem of wanting to be in a relationship.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Uske sath, ya kisi aur ke sath relationship?
dialog.content_en: With him, or a relationship with someone?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Uske sath... woh perfect tha (ya kam se kam mujhe laga), but also, I'm lonely, and it's hard to process not being in a relationship during this pandemic.
dialog.content_en: With him... he was perfect (or at least I thought), but also, I'm lonely, and it's hard to process not being in a relationship during the pandemic.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya tumne online doosri connections try ki hain? Bahut saare log is pandemic mein home par hain, you may meet someone much better.
dialog.content_en: Have you tried making other connections online? A lot of people are home during this pandemic, you may meet someone much better.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: True. In the meantime, main usko get over karne ke liye kya kar sakti hoon?
dialog.content_en: True. What can I do to get over him in the meantime?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Keep busy! Sad hone ke bajaye get mad!
dialog.content_en: Keep busy! Get mad instead of sad!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main toh contact nahi karti agar woh mujhe contact nahi kar raha tha. You deserve better than that!
dialog.content_en: I would not contact him if he was not contacting me.  You deserve better than that!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Lol. Mujhe lagta hai I can do that!
dialog.content_en: Lol. I think I can do that!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yes, hum women better function karti hain jab hum pissed off ho jaati hain!
dialog.content_en: Yes, we women function better when we get pissed!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: You're right. Agar usne mujhe phir se contact kiya toh what should I do? Kya main conversation ko play out hone doon and dekhun kya hota hai?
dialog.content_en: You're right. What do I do if he contacts me again? Do I let the conversation play out and see what happens?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Play it cool and ready raho ek whole bunch of fun things batane ke liye jo tum kar rahi thi.
dialog.content_en: Play it cool and be ready to make up a whole bunch of fun things you have been doing.
